turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided on the zero?
We've been here a minute, Hale, and my call isn't until 4:40. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
No. Nothing is resolved: the zero is still in the gradebook and you haven't answered my question. If you write up anything with my name on it, I want to read it first.
Asking twice doesn't change my answer. Take the zero off Owen's mark, and then we can talk about what gets written up.
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
You can need it all you like. What do you have besides a request that I agree?
